Description
The RKP 450 Pendulum Impact Tester is ideally designed and created to provide an excellent quality performance and functionality for very specific purposes. It is a pendulum impact tester which may be used for Charpy, Izod, Brugger, impact tensile and wedge impact tests which is basically compliant to the DIN, EN, ASTM, ISO and BS standards. It is a special model which enables a temperature-controlled wedge impact tests to be done which ranges from -45°C to +85°C. The standard unit comprises of a vibration-damping steel casting which provides a high level of mechanical stiffness that ensures a very dependable test results. The operation is ideally simple and convenient with central controls with an easy specimen insertion and pendulum release capacity.
